current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: backbeat-centered groove; straight, shuffle or triplet-derived feel depending profile
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: 4/8-bar vocal/instrumental phrases with turnarounds and call-response
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: blues/gospel-derived tonal harmony, dominant color and repeated progressions with variation
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: groove-oriented bass tied to kick with fills into phrase boundaries
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: firm snare backbeat, kick pocket, hats/ride; shuffle variants allowed
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: voice or horn/guitar lead, piano/electric piano, guitar, bass, drums, optional brass
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: rhythm section pocket supports lead; responses occupy gaps rather than overlap constantly
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: verse/chorus, blues-based or sectional song forms
current_profile_snapshot.dynamic_behavior: medium-to-strong groove dynamics with chorus lift
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: expressive bends/scoops, guitar accents and strong drum backbeat
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: pocket may sit slightly behind/around beat but remains ensemble-coherent
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: expression and articulation curves for lead plus rhythm-section dynamics
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: lead and bass clear; backbeat present but not crushing
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: warm/punchy master with dynamic vocal or lead space
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: map keys/guitar/horns and drum resources with groove-preserving articulations
